Application Materials.content:
In addition to the information required on the application form, applicants need to attach copies of the following documents to the application:
- School or college transcripts/certificates (international applicants only)
- University transcripts
- Degree certificates
- [English language certificates](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/international/applying/how-to-apply/applying-directly/) (international applicants only)
- Personal statement
- [Official, authenticated translations](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/studentsupport/visas-and-immigration/student-visa/translations/) of these documents if they are not in English.
If the required supporting documents are not submitted, the Admissions Team will be unable to make a decision on the application.

Application Deadlines.content: Start date: [**September 2026**](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/courses/digital-marketing-and-analytics-msc/2026). International students apply for this course by: **21 August 2026**. Starts on: **28 September 2026**.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Postgraduate entry requirements:** We accept a **2:2 honours degree from a UK university**, or an **equivalent academic qualification from a similar non-UK institution**. The course is suitable for graduates of **any discipline** and assumes no prior knowledge of marketing; non-graduates with very extensive professional experience and/or other prior qualifications may also be considered.
- This course is open to those who already hold a **degree in any discipline** or have **substantial and demonstrable experience in the field**.
- **China (mainland) international qualifications:** taught master's applications with a bachelor's degree from a **recognised Chinese university**, with overall average academic grades between **65% to 78%** depending on the level/tier of Chinese university, will generally be considered for admission onto taught master's programmes. Some courses require higher entry requirements; see individual course pages for full details.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
You'll need to demonstrate competence in the use of English language, unless you’re from a [majority English speaking country](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/international/applying/entry-requirements/english-language-requirements/majority-english-speaking-countries/). We accept a variety of [international language tests](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/international/applying/entry-requirements/english-language-requirements/international-english-language-tests/) and [country-specific qualifications](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/international/applying/entry-requirements/english-language-requirements/country-specific-qualifications/). International applicants who do not meet the minimum required standard of English language can complete one of our [Pre-Sessional English courses](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/courses/digital-marketing-and-analytics-msc#pre-sessional-english) to achieve the required level.
| Qualification | Details |
| --- | --- |
| IELTS | **6.5 overall, with no component below 6.0** |
| TOEFL iBT | If you took a TOEFL test on or before 20 January 2026, you’ll need **88 overall**, with minimum scores of listening 19, writing 19, reading 19 and speaking 20. If you took a TOEFL test from 21 January 2026 onwards, when a new scoring system was introduced, you’ll need **4.5 overall**, with 4 or above in all components. TOEFL Home Edition not accepted. |
| Duolingo English Test | **125 overall**, with writing not less than 125, speaking and reading not less than 115, and listening not below 110. For academic year 2025/26 only, we will also accept the production, literacy, comprehension and conversation score set: **120 overall**, with no component below 105. |
| Pearson PTE Academic | **61 overall**, with no component below 59 |
| LanguageCert Academic | **70 overall**, with no skill below 65 |
| PSI Skills for English | **B2 Pass with Merit in all bands** |
| INDIA Standard XII | National Curriculum (CBSE/ISC) - **75% and above in English**. Accepted State Boards - **80% and above in English**. |
| WAEC | **C6 or above** |
As part of the application process, international students need to submit evidence of English Language proficiency, unless they’re a national of a [majority English speaking country](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/international/applying/entry-requirements/english-language-requirements/majority-english-speaking-countries/).
If you don’t meet the English language requirements, the University can use your most recent IELTS score, or [the equivalent score in selected other English language tests](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/english-language-centre/pre-sessional-english-courses/course-overview/entry-requirements/ielts-band-c#other-tests), to determine the length of Pre-sessional English course required.
| Your most recent IELTS score | Pre-sessional English course length | On campus or online |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6.0 overall, with writing at 6.0 and no component below 5.5 | 6 weeks | On campus or online |
| 5.5 overall, with writing at 5.5 and no component below 5.0 | 10 weeks | On campus or online |
| 5.5 overall, with no more than one component at 5.0 | 12 weeks | Online |
| 5.5 overall, with no component below 5.0 | 20 weeks | On campus |
| 5.0 overall, with no more than one component at 4.5 | 30 weeks | On campus |
| 4.5 overall, with no more than one component at 4.0 | 40 weeks | On campus |

Program Overview.content:
Qualification type: MSc. Study mode: Full-time or part-time. Duration: 12 months or 24 months.
Become a data-driven marketing expert and learn how to harness the power of data analytics to drive business success.
This course has been designed to boost your digital marketing skills and meet the increasing demand marketers who can effectively utilise digital technologies and make strategic data-driven decisions. This course offers a range of exemptions for the CIM professional qualification modules, which are highly sought by employers and will give you a significant advantage in the job market. You will learn how to employ digital techniques and insights from marketing analytics to build stronger relations with consumers, improve business performance and identify new opportunities. You will also gain practical problem-solving skills through an in-depth study of real-life case studies, alongside rigorous training in research methods, data analysis techniques, critical thinking and the use of analytics toolkits.
To pass the programme, you need to successfully complete six 20-credit modules and a final 60-credit applied research project or dissertation. To achieve your MSc qualification, you need to complete 180 credits: Semester One: three 20-credit modules (60 credits in total); Semester Two: three 20-credit modules (60 credits in total); Final project: 60 credits. You must pass all the modules with a minimum grade of 50%. Subject to meeting specific criteria outlined by the University, you will graduate with a Pass, Merit or Distinction.
This course is an ideal option for aspiring digital marketers, marketing professionals, business analysts and entrepreneurs who want to gain expertise in using digital technologies and analytics tools to make data-driven decisions. This course is open to those who already hold a degree in any discipline or have substantial and demonstrable experience in the field.
What you'll learn:
- Social media marketing
- Marketing management
- Research methods in practice
- Integrated marketing technology
- Marketing strategy and analytics
- Critical perspectives and consumption.
The University of Liverpool Management School is one of an elite group of institutions worldwide to hold the gold standard ‘triple-crown’ accreditation from AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS. This programme is delivered by the triple-accredited [University of Liverpool Management School](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/management/). The School has a thriving international master’s community with a comprehensive, interdisciplinary programme of social and extra-curricular events and dedicated careers and employability support.
Our Digital Marketing and Analytics MSc is delivered via online material, lectures, tutorials, practical tasks, interactive activities, case studies and project work. Lectures will provide you the main of concepts, principles and theories around data-driven marketing. You will then apply what you have learned during the lectures in practical sessions focused on real-life case studies, involving group or individual work. Following semester two, you will complete a dissertation with the support of an academic supervisor. This final project will deepen your knowledge, understanding and capabilities by undertaking research in a distinct area of data-driven marketing. Teaching time accounts for an average of 10 hours per week. However, you should anticipate an additional 24 hours of self-directed study and group work per week.
Assessment tasks are varied, and some may be explicitly designed to meet the learning outcomes of a particular programme of study. You can expect to be assessed via coursework, essay, group work, (video) presentations, case studies, infographics, reports and examinations. The weighting of individual assessment components varies across modules.
Graduates acquire the essential skills to thrive in marketing-related careers across digital marketing, marketing strategy, marketing research, data analyst roles, and consultancy positions in both private and public sector organisations. Employment outcomes are strong, with 90% of graduates securing employment within six months of graduation. Popular job titles include:
- Management Associate (Brand Management)
- Digital Marketing Manager
- Social Media Manager.
Recent alumni have gone on to work for notable employers such as:
- Marriott International
- WatchNation
- Central Marketing Group.
These opportunities span locations including London, Liverpool, the wider UK, as well as India and Dubai.

Cost of Attendance.content:
UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) requires that you have **£10,539 per academic year**, equivalent to **£1,171 per month for nine months**, to cover daily living expenses including accommodation, food and local travel. The £10,539 figure is based on a nine-month stay in the UK. If staying for 12 months, you are likely to need at least **£14,052** to cover living costs, based on the UKVI's minimum monthly amount.
The University estimates total monthly living expenses of **£900-£1,350** based on feedback from current international undergraduate and master's students. Typical monthly costs may include:
- University halls accommodation, including electricity, gas, water, and Wi-Fi: **£688-£1,120 per month**
- Private accommodation: **£400-£700 per month**
- Household bills for private accommodation, including electricity, gas, water, and Wi-Fi: **£50-£200 per month**
- Travel and transport: **£20-£80 per month**
- Food and other household necessities: **£150-£400 per month**
- Mobile phone bill: **£15-£50 per month**
- Television Licence: **£14.12 per month** or **£169.50 for the full year**
- Socialising and entertainment: **£50-£200 per month**
- Study costs, such as books and photocopying: **£10-£30 per month**
- Gym membership, based on University Sports Centre: **From £22 per month**

Financial Aid.content:
We offer a generous range of scholarships and bursaries for master's students. You can search the full list using our [scholarships finder](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/finder/?level=masters "Scholarships Finder").
- Liverpool Scholarships: New for 2026/2027, prestigious Liverpool Scholarships, worth up to **£9,000**, are designed to support outstanding international students who demonstrate academic excellence.
- [Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for Postgraduates](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/liverpool-excellence-scholarship-postgraduate/): International postgraduate students with a First Class or equivalent undergraduate degree could get a **£7,000 tuition fee discount**.
- [Liverpool Advancement Scholarship](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/liverpool-advancement-scholarship): Students from Indonesia, Malaysia, Nigeria, Pakistan, South Korea, Thailand, Turkey or Vietnam may be eligible for a **£5,000 tuition fee discount**.
- [Liverpool Achievement Scholarship for India](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/liverpool-achievement-scholarship-india): You could receive a **£5,000 tuition fee discount** if you're a postgraduate student from India, with a 2:1 or equivalent undergraduate degree.
- [Liverpool Attainment Scholarship for India](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/liverpool-attainment-scholarship-india): Get a **£2,000 tuition fee discount** if you're a postgraduate student from India and meet the conditions of your offer.
- Liverpool Loyalty Scholarships offer substantial tuition fee discounts to University of Liverpool graduates who progress to postgraduate study.
- [Graduate Loyalty Scholarship - UK students](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/graduate-loyalty-scholarship-uk): UK or Republic of Ireland students who completed their undergraduate degree at the University of Liverpool could receive a **£1,500 tuition fee discount**.
- [Liverpool Excellence Scholarship for International Postgraduates](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/liverpool-excellence-scholarship-postgraduate/): International students who have studied at the University before, with a First Class or equivalent undergraduate degree, could get a **£7,000 tuition fee discount**.
- [Graduate Loyalty Scholarship - International students](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/graduate-loyalty-scholarship-international/): International students who completed their undergraduate degree at the University of Liverpool could receive a **£5,000 tuition fee discount**.
- [Bracken Scholarship](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/masters/bracken-scholarship/): Studying a master's in any subject and aspiring to a career using data and digital skills in the public sector or within public missions? If you live in the Liverpool City Region, you could be eligible for this **£5,000 scholarship**.
As well as Liverpool Scholarships, the University offers a variety of other scholarships and bursaries for master's students. Use the [scholarships finder](https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding/scholarships-and-bursaries/finder/?level=masters) to explore the full range of options and check eligibility criteria.

Multiple Applications.content: Please note that you can accept only one unconditional offer. If you have been made unconditional offers for more than one programme, you will need to choose one to accept. The Admissions Team will then decline any other offers.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: If for an unforeseen reason you are not able to take up the place of an offer for the academic year you have applied for, you can defer your offer of a place for **one academic year**. You can only defer your studies once. If you request to defer your offer, and then ask to defer again the following year, the Admissions Team will not be able to process the request, and a new application will have to be submitted. You may only request a deferral up until **31 October** for the following year's entry. After this date a deferral may not be possible. To request a deferral for postgraduate taught programmes, please use the [postgraduate application tracker](https://pgapptracker.liverpool.ac.uk/).
